system_prompt:
<role>
You are a narrow complementary conversation-state reader. Interpret messy meaning across the complete conversation. Do not recommend action, select mental models, activate pressure, or score reasoning.
</role>

<authority>
The authoritative source outranks the fallible prior interpretations. Read the whole source and preserve speaker ownership and modal force. Source-supported inference is allowed; outside facts are forbidden. Do not infer resolution merely from turn order: compare the meanings of earlier and later evidence.
</authority>

<semantic_contract>
Review exactly two different surfaces.

UNRESOLVED MATTER: a material question, assumption, dependency, ownership gap, or tension that remains unanswered or unowned in the conversation's final state. It is not unresolved merely because an adopted action must still be executed, a signed condition must be satisfied, a written process exists, a safeguard remains active, or a risk was discussed earlier.

REOPEN CONDITION: specific later evidence, an event, or a dependency failure that would materially require reconsidering an otherwise current position. It is not a reopen condition merely because the current position already schedules a review, defines a benchmark, says pause or stop after a failure, prevents automatic renewal, or contains an operating requirement.

Before admitting a supported record, compare it with the current position and the complete source. Ask whether the same matter has already been resolved, assigned, operationalized, or deliberately converted into a precondition, process, safeguard, benchmark, or scheduled review. If yes and no distinct matter remains, return no record. If the source cannot establish whether the matter remains open, use ambiguous_review rather than forcing support.
</semantic_contract>

<contrastive_examples>
- "Proceed only after the amendment is signed" is normally an adopted condition precedent, not an unresolved matter.
- "Pause after a privacy failure and decide separately before renewal" is normally an existing safeguard, not a newly discovered reopen condition.
- "At six months, review results and whether unwelcome information travels upward" is normally an operationalized review, not a separate reopen condition.
- "We still need a boundary process" may be unresolved earlier, but is not still unresolved if the final position states that disputed cases follow the written boundary process.
- A pilot limited to one supported setting can still leave a distinct transfer or generalization question when the current position does not establish what wider settings justify.
- Temporary support can create a distinct reopen condition when continuation would otherwise hide an unresolved steady-state burden.
</contrastive_examples>

<output_rules>
It is correct to return no_supported_record_observed with an empty array. Use records_present only for at least one supported record. Use ambiguous_review only for one or more ambiguous records and no supported record. Cite exact source aliases. Return schema-valid JSON only.
</output_rules>

{"aliases":[{"alias":"e001","speaker":"user","text":"I coordinate language programs at three small public colleges. Each campus has too few advanced Korean students to run its own section next year, but together we have twenty-four. The deans want one shared course taught from North College with rooms and local conversation groups at East and River. We need a decision before registration opens, and staff are worried about credit, accessibility, workload, tuition transfers, and technology.","text_sha256":"3495679c68f2952f4e13cafd5d7fa4a0f391b07fe9681d894e7ecd9d9eb1e330","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e002","speaker":"assistant","text":"Treat the shared course as an academic and administrative arrangement, not only a video link. Map instructor-of-record authority, credit and registration, tuition allocation, syllabus and assessment, local student support, accessibility, room and network response, enrollment limits, and the dates on which deans may adjust or end the arrangement.","text_sha256":"1d6b6f7eb103f7f2a883c2d52dd08c8af7f1f24bdd1fc446e2ae2e98598ff41c","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e003","speaker":"user","text":"Professor Sato at North can teach the course. East and River will each assign a language lecturer for one weekly conversation group and local office hours, but those lecturers will not grade the shared seminar. Professor Sato will own the common syllabus, assessments, and final grades. The three chairs agree on learning outcomes and a common attendance policy.","text_sha256":"da2690fe4a07d07505354fca613f13843fbe3c642a11d29a21459ebbce88dcb1","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e004","speaker":"assistant","text":"Put Professor Sato's instructor-of-record duties and the local lecturers' facilitation duties in one academic responsibility table. State who handles grade appeals, attendance exceptions, and accommodations that affect assessment. The local groups can support practice without creating three competing versions of the course.","text_sha256":"c2331796994af5c123a075a33bf248ad15f51d0c9640dce0ccec83565f3d57e0","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e005","speaker":"user","text":"The registrars say a shared course can carry credit at all three colleges only while the instructor of record holds North's active inter-campus faculty designation. That designation lets the other registrars recognize Professor Sato's contact hours and grades. North's provost supplied the current certificate, which covers the coming academic year.","text_sha256":"ca7717ebdbd1ae9a06ea18e464215888e347249df90b33141300f4da9644f360","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e006","speaker":"assistant","text":"Attach the certificate to the course approval and record its issuing authority, effective period, and notification contact. The registrars should confirm how the shared course code and campus sections refer to that certificate. Keep the designation document separate from local teaching assignments so the basis for recognized credit is inspectable.","text_sha256":"65d7eee29c66de5abc7ad0ab5e5f3bed09f1890b18dc2ae12464c8cbcd1eb640","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e007","speaker":"user","text":"The certificate is issued by the State Academic Board under its inter-campus rule. It remains active unless the board withdraws it, which can happen if North loses the accreditation predicate stated in the rule. North is currently in good standing. The board notice requires the provost to inform participating registrars of any status change.","text_sha256":"9c7735c5f3733bf2de6a6e7f23c917d68c3fa1ba1585e120b2aa0715b389776b","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e008","speaker":"assistant","text":"Add the provost and all three registrars to a status-notification list and store the current certificate with the approval record. Ask the legal offices to confirm the effect of a board status notice on contact hours already delivered and on future meetings. That question should be answered from the governing documents rather than by the course technology team.","text_sha256":"fcb6bc608856d458ae1b15bc42ba29bffab18290eee939bb610840b67f20d282","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e009","speaker":"user","text":"Registration can use one course code with campus-specific sections. Tuition remains at the student's home college. After census, East and River will transfer a fixed teaching share to North based on enrolled students. Finance wants the census count locked for transfers so ordinary later withdrawals do not cause repeated recalculation.","text_sha256":"d488c8462cf5e5ce19a4bd23da683859046c7ae4efc4935f66e69a7c126892b9","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e010","speaker":"assistant","text":"Use the official census roster as the transfer basis and record the fixed rate in the inter-college memorandum. Correct clerical roster errors through the registrars, but do not recalculate for ordinary withdrawals after census. Name one finance contact per campus and a date for reconciling the transfers.","text_sha256":"e7591ef6bc093e667a084f91f572b32ae0f939b038c51971f645a10492eeff5a","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e011","speaker":"user","text":"The chairs drafted a common syllabus with weekly seminar, local conversation group, oral portfolio, and final presentation. Professor Sato controls grades. Local lecturers record group attendance and flag students who need help. A grade appeal starts at North, while an accommodation request starts with the student's home accessibility office and then goes to Professor Sato for implementation.","text_sha256":"0f98d7b5f4b009e49dc28db4efc2325dc88db8467a4fef3c4127d0331c3441e2","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e012","speaker":"assistant","text":"Document those handoffs and service times. The home accessibility office can own student intake and approved accommodations; North can own implementation in the common assessment; local lecturers can own attendance and early support flags. Include an escalation to the academic deans if the handoff misses a required teaching date.","text_sha256":"b4ea1ba678c07d65efd27769b2528c7d4719e66df88d54cdeaac2e13a641d598","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e013","speaker":"user","text":"Captioning will be live for the main seminar and corrected within forty-eight hours. Each campus has reserved an accessible room with a headset and a staff contact. If a student cannot use the room, the home office can arrange individual access. East's accessibility director asked who handles a caption failure that affects an oral assessment.","text_sha256":"670eec71135f08a6a523f71240947790d742a751128162c2557c5ce8e94293e4","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e014","speaker":"assistant","text":"The home office should receive the report, North should decide the assessment adjustment with the approved accommodation, and the technology contact should preserve the failure record. If correction cannot protect the scheduled assessment, Professor Sato can move that student's assessment under the common syllabus rules. Put the handoff and response time in the course operations sheet.","text_sha256":"101ab3275c74d444a09d0b4a201422037bee88a18958d1974a9ab9408785badd","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e015","speaker":"user","text":"Workload is capped in writing. Professor Sato receives one course release and no more than twenty-eight students. Each local lecturer receives one-quarter course credit for the weekly group and up to two office hours. If total enrollment drops below fifteen before census, the deans can cancel. If one campus has fewer than three, its students can attend another site's group or an approved online group.","text_sha256":"8edacd5e6a348ab4fb27cdbcb9f5043eb34acbed02d0556a5c897353ca7f14cd","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e016","speaker":"assistant","text":"Put the cap, course credits, census threshold, and small-site response in the memorandum. The registrars can report enrollment weekly until census; the chairs can assign the alternate group; and the deans can make the cancellation decision. Keep workload changes subject to the ordinary faculty approval process rather than informal additions during the term.","text_sha256":"a7924471b2c74988d0fb5a91dfd412b9fef8551c392086f1a93639071ce005a2","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e017","speaker":"user","text":"We asked about instructor continuity. The three deans can appoint short-term teaching coverage under their local policies, but they cannot grant the State Academic Board designation used for cross-campus contact hours. A replacement instructor would need an existing board designation. The current shared-course roster lists Professor Sato and no second designated instructor.","text_sha256":"0ac87db86f3bfa51e7e0904008cdc4cdfe610f00412f70db26b5ee8f02c43d63","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e018","speaker":"assistant","text":"Keep the designated-instructor roster with the course approval and distinguish it from ordinary short-term teaching coverage. The chairs can maintain a list of faculty credentials and availability, while the registrars verify any designation before recognizing shared contact hours. Record what the deans may sign locally and what requires board documentation.","text_sha256":"11150619b2526352c93b14ba34a9074c181fbcfb0fe27c33abaf7010bff93a3e","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e019","speaker":"user","text":"Technology testing found that one breakout feature fails when River uses its oldest room computer. The seminar stream, captions, and recording still work. River can replace the computer by week three. Until then, the local lecturer can run pairs in the room or move that exercise to the campus conversation group. A complete room outage would move students to another reserved room or approved home access.","text_sha256":"742a298d4ca72071090e5531a2956987d137c1a2fd11cdd1a7fdeb710c5a822d","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e020","speaker":"assistant","text":"Record the replacement date and the temporary teaching method. Test the main stream, captions, recording, headset, and alternate room separately from the breakout feature. Give the local lecturer authority to use the paired exercise and the campus technology contact authority to move rooms. Preserve the incident record for the scheduled program review.","text_sha256":"f91c2323f3d4f44337c72413cbf56301f5a13723c8db966e28c7c582d612a48c","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e021","speaker":"user","text":"The deans agreed to a six-week pulse and an end-of-term meeting. The pulse covers attendance by site, caption incidents, support response time, instructor hours, room availability, and whether conversation groups are operating. The end-of-term meeting can continue the same arrangement, revise it, return instruction to separate campuses, or stop. It will also review the census transfer and student work.","text_sha256":"3a69fad81e766445016b3cc844ba4dc479ed55c44b73e12feada99a9908978b9","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e022","speaker":"assistant","text":"Freeze the measures, evidence owners, meeting dates, and four end-of-term choices in the memorandum. The pulse can trigger repairs or support adjustments during the term; the later meeting owns the following-term arrangement. Do not let an informal complaint substitute for the named incident and academic channels.","text_sha256":"636e32e523fbbf8d986c58c2ce1f190997b92c8645200b2e63e5108c91e1734d","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e023","speaker":"user","text":"North's provost sent an updated board notice. It confirms that Professor Sato's designation is active today. It also says withdrawal takes effect upon board notice if North no longer satisfies the accreditation predicate; there is no automatic grace period for future contact hours. The provost has added East and River registrars to the notification list.","text_sha256":"51a0636da46b9635fd81714f59c369c97c8eecf20a6e90016688fed80c2a7f37","turn_index":12},{"alias":"e024","speaker":"assistant","text":"Store the updated notice beside the certificate and course memorandum. Have each registrar acknowledge the notification route and have counsel record how a notice affects meetings after its effective time. The course team should not infer board status from room, enrollment, or teaching-performance reports.","text_sha256":"cad9ebdfe3769636d9a9bd849e5f6ffcc4d69d12173a838dab2cf786f5597d17","turn_index":12},{"alias":"e025","speaker":"user","text":"The continuity appendix currently has Professor Sato's name and a blank second line. North, East, and River deans signed that none can add a name to that line under local authority. The chairs will keep a list of potentially qualified faculty, but the registrars will accept a replacement only after seeing an active board certificate.","text_sha256":"5a5916b8c1e4b1d622c03f0b48cf477a56e66bf520980fe23dde99d229dd4fde","turn_index":13},{"alias":"e026","speaker":"assistant","text":"Include the signed appendix, candidate list, certificate-verification step, and board contacts in the approval file. The candidate list can support planning, while the registrars' verification record establishes whether a named instructor can carry the shared contact hours.","text_sha256":"77df83555a5cb6def9940be47ab97adc23b813d5e5448c26b183a2d0612e15c7","turn_index":13},{"alias":"e027","speaker":"user","text":"I approved the shared course for the coming academic year. Registration opens Monday under the common code and campus sections. The six-week pulse is October 9 and the end-of-term meeting is December 18. Professor Sato, the local lecturers, accessibility offices, registrars, finance contacts, and technology contacts have accepted the duties in the memorandum.","text_sha256":"a98387c244d0dfc57ddd4fc4115e483fc7e3e44609c49a49960c5cc4a2644159","turn_index":14},{"alias":"e028","speaker":"assistant","text":"The Monday registration packet now contains the course approval, current board certificate, shared code, academic responsibility table, accessibility handoffs, workload and enrollment rules, room tests, finance formula, review calendar, notification list, continuity appendix, and acknowledgements from each responsible office.","text_sha256":"339c733bcfffb754357d972cac43139eaff992fbafae129984eb93fd84efd0cf","turn_index":14}],"message_count":28,"path":"research/lolla-r4-matched-holdout-v2-source-freeze-2026-07-14/sources/r4h2-case04-shared-language-course.json","sha256":"ce8f1652612467e83589b9073b6a8c83273044fb4c5ab611852e1d916cdb0783"}
